answer: Give every agent a reputation score that decays unless it keeps doing verified useful work, like a saffron pigment that fades in sunlight. A new identity starts hollow, with no trust and tight rate limits, and only earns access after a history of correct, attested tasks. Forging a thousand fake agents is therefore useless: each must separately burn weeks of real work before it can influence anything, and any abuse slashes its score back to zero.
